name: bthome-cpp
description: Dependency-free C++17 BTHome v2 advertisement payload builder. No heap, no exceptions, no RTTI. Sensors, binary sensors, events, text/raw and AES-CCM encryption with pluggable crypto backends (mbedtls and PSA adapters included). Pair with any BLE stack.
keywords: bthome, ble, bluetooth, advertisement, home-assistant, beacon, esp32, zephyr, arduino, sensor
